global_rules: 对白或内心独白镜头使用 locked-off 或极慢微推，必须覆盖完整台词和表情停顿
动作镜头只在准备、发力、冲击、回收节点运镜；单镜只允许一个主要运动方向
表演完成前不切镜，不用运镜制造虚假节奏
每镜首帧必须是场景动作状态，不得是孤立人物肖像

shots.camera: locked close-up; hold hands and face while typing and rubbing eyes; no pan
locked over-shoulder; only screen glow and hands move; no camera travel
locked medium close-up until impact, one brief jolt at phone contact, then hold recovery
locked medium shot; one short push-in only during desk strike, then hold Feige's finished expression
locked two-shot for full dialogue; no orbit, no lateral move
locked group composition; hold the coworker standing, tears and fist; cut only after sitting
locked phone/face close-up; one slow tilt up only after notification appears
locked over-shoulder while typing and sending; hold one beat after click
locked medium shot for shout and group reaction; one short push-in on red warning only
locked office frame for call; hold after hang-up, then slow two-second rack focus to doorway
single continuous slow pull-back only after copy-paste rhythm is established; no additional movement
